description: This Python test file verifies the behavior of the 'handle_get_run_command' function and the 'create_minimal_project_config' function within the 'universalinit.cli' module. It uses mock objects to simulate different project types and their associated run commands, ensuring that the functions produce correct JSON output containing the project type and run command based on various configurations.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Represents initial configuration info for templates, including the command to run tools.

classes.name: RunTool
classes.description: Encapsulates the command string and working directory for running project-specific tools.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Handles project initialization, utilizing a template factory to create templates.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to fetch the run command for a specific project type, and outputs a JSON with project type and command.

methods.name: create_minimal_project_config
methods.description: Generates a minimal project configuration JSON for a given project type.
